mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 3.0% triggers a monetary tightening expectation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL MoM change > 3.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signals a 'stagflationary' environment where the central bank is constrained in its response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as investors anticipate both inflation and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, which in a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A unemployment rate above 5.0% triggers a recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to deteriorating labor market conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and low housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening consumer demand, which in the context of a high inflation environment leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and HOUST < 1100.0, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% during a period of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals a monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with high inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
